description: Both uniform models share these exact GLB target names. Apply to every mesh exposing the target in morphTargetDictionary.

JawOpen.description: Jaw opens around its anatomical hinge.

Scream.description: Open jaw, raised inner brows, widened mouth and upper lids.

Cry.description: Narrowed eyelids, raised inner brows and downturned mouth.

Fear.description: Wide eyelids, raised brows and a tense partly open mouth.

Dead.description: Closed eyelids and a relaxed slightly open jaw.

blending.compoundRule: Choose one of Scream, Cry, Fear or Dead. Do not add JawOpen, BrowFurrow, browInnerUp, mouthFrownLeft or mouthFrownRight over these compounds; each includes its facial components. Dead already includes closed eyelids, so do not add Blink or independent eyelid targets to it.
blending.blinkRule: Choose Blink or the independent eyeBlinkLeft/eyeBlinkRight pair, rather than summing both mechanisms.
blending.neutralRule: Reset target weights to zero when returning to neutral. Idle and Run intentionally contain no weights channels.

materialRule: Uniform_FabricPalette uses vertex colors, a fabric normal map, and a roughness map. Keep vertexColors enabled and material.color white. Skin maps and source UVs remain embedded.
notIncluded: Tears, X-eyes, and other screen or eye overlays are generated by the game's death-effects system, not baked into these textures.
